subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: After repairing the core boundary, should QA Lab permanently own @openclaw/matrix as a runtime workspace dependency for the migrated Matrix QA implementation?
rationale: The ownership move follows the migrated code, but repository policy requires explicit exact-head authorization for dependency-graph changes and a human must confirm this package relationship is intended.

options.title: Approve QA Lab ownership
options.body: Keep the workspace dependency in QA Lab after the Matrix-specific core SDK calls are removed and approve the resulting exact head through the dependency guard.

options.title: Keep dependency in the shim
options.body: Retain Matrix dependency ownership in qa-matrix and expose only a generic QA Lab execution contract, avoiding a QA Lab-to-Matrix runtime package edge.

recommendation.title: Approve QA Lab ownership
recommendation.body: Keep the workspace dependency in QA Lab after the Matrix-specific core SDK calls are removed and approve the resulting exact head through the dependency guard.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QA Lab and Gateway history makes this the best available cross-boundary reviewer, with repository administration or security still required for the final exact-head authorization.
